text: I can rewrite a free-text log line as a structured JSON event with a stable message and named fields, and say which fields must never be logged.
I can pick the right level for a handled retry, a failed request and a process crash, and explain why I alert on error rates rather than log lines.
I can trace how a correlation ID is generated, stored in request context and carried across HTTP calls and a queue hop.
I can sketch a centralized logging pipeline (emit, collect, buffer, process, store) and compare a full-text index with a label-only index.
I can estimate daily log volume and cost from QPS, lines per request and bytes per line, and design a sampling policy that keeps every error and whole requests.
